about.label: 01 / ABOUT
about.paragraph1: My career brings together technology, management, and experience in environments where systems need to work in the real world. Over the years, I have built solutions to simplify processes, automate workflows, and turn operational challenges into practical digital products.
about.paragraph2: Today, my work focuses on software development, artificial intelligence, automation, and digital transformation — always pursuing solutions that deliver measurable impact and make sense for the people who actually use them.

page.seoDescription: Discover Hefesto, a platform built to optimize 190/193 emergency response and incident creation through software, automation, and integration.
page.summary: A platform built to optimize the initial cycle of 190/193 emergency response, structuring information, automating steps, and integrating resources to make incident creation faster and more efficient.

problem.label: THE PROBLEM
problem.p1: The initial handling of an emergency requires several pieces of information to be understood, organized, and recorded before the operational flow can continue.
problem.p2: In a high-volume environment, manual entry and repetitive tasks increased the time needed to turn a call into a structured incident.

solution.label: THE SOLUTION
solution.p1: Hefesto organizes the initial incident cycle into a single operational experience, using structured workflows, automation, lookups, and integrations to support the operator while the record is being built.
solution.p2: The solution brings together location, call information, structured narrative generation, and supporting resources to reduce repetitive steps and increase the consistency of the information.

flow.ariaLabel: Hefesto flow: call, location, collection, narrative, and incident

result.text: Reducing incident creation time in a high-volume operation represents a significant operational gain and allows the operator to focus more attention on the call itself.

experience.label: 04 / EXPERIENCE
experience.intro: My professional journey has been shaped by technology, management, and operational experience. That combination gave me a perspective I consider essential: understanding the problem before building the solution.
experience.closingLine1: Technology has changed over the years.

formation.title: TECHNOLOGY FOUNDATION
formation.text: A degree in Information Systems established the technical foundation for a career focused on software development, process analysis, and practical applications of technology.

processes.title: TECHNOLOGY APPLIED TO PROCESSES
processes.text: Experience with administrative processes led to the creation of systems to digitize workflows, organize information, and replace manual controls with more efficient solutions.

operations.title: TECHNOLOGY IN CRITICAL OPERATIONS
operations.text: My work expanded into systems used in high-demand operational environments, bringing software development, automation, and real user needs even closer together.

today.title: SOFTWARE, AI & AUTOMATION
today.text: Today, I focus on building systems, automations, and AI-powered solutions, combining operational experience, software architecture, and a strong focus on efficiency.

technology.label: 05 / TECHNOLOGY
technology.body: My work combines software development, data, artificial intelligence, automation, and system integrations. Technology choices are driven by the problem being solved, the architecture required, and the environment in which the solution will operate.

software.title: SOFTWARE ENGINEERING
software.description: Development of applications, APIs, and digital products with a focus on clean architecture, maintainability, and continuous evolution.

data.title: DATA & BACK-END
data.description: Data and service architecture for applications that require consistency, integration, and room to scale.

ai.title: AI & AUTOMATION
ai.description: Using artificial intelligence and automation to reduce manual work, structure information, and make processes faster and smarter.

infra.title: INFRASTRUCTURE & INTEGRATIONS
infra.description: Integration across applications, telephony, and external services, with environments designed for deployment, isolation, and continuous operation.

publications.label: 06 / PUBLICATIONS
publications.body: Part of my work also involves turning technical concepts into practical knowledge. I write about artificial intelligence, automation, and technology with a focus on making complex tools more useful for people and businesses.
